title: Interactive Architecture Lab
description: Run a guided, read-only trace across the same production topology used by the README architecture diagram.

portfolio-edge.responsibility: Hosts the public portfolio, admin console, serverless BFF routes, chat streaming and first-party tracking entry points.

agent-runtime.responsibility: Applies safety policy, plans one semantic execution branch, compacts conversation memory and streams the final answer.

knowledge-service.responsibility: Runs hybrid BM25 and vector retrieval, RRF fusion, confidence gating and canonical source resolution.

model-gateway.responsibility: Builds prompts, routes model tiers, enforces token budgets and normalizes provider streaming.

mcp-gateway.responsibility: Executes typed tools behind permission, confirmation, idempotency, audit and response-sanitization gates.

content-control.responsibility: Owns versioned content, durable jobs and a transactional outbox in one PostgreSQL transaction boundary.

projection-workers.responsibility: Consumes independent search and RAG topics and materializes replaceable OpenSearch and pgvector read models.

notification-service.responsibility: Resolves recipients, leases delivery work and records per-recipient status before provider delivery.

tracking-api.responsibility: Validates first-party event envelopes, bounds payload size and reduces geolocation to city-level metadata.

analytics-aggregator.responsibility: Deduplicates events, builds sessions, computes rollups and journeys, and provides replayable visitor intelligence.

scenarios.label: Ask AI Agent
scenarios.summary: A grounded portfolio question is planned, retrieved, generated and streamed to the viewer.
scenarios.result: Grounded answer streamed with canonical first-party sources

steps.label: Submit question
steps.detail: The visitor asks about a portfolio project.

steps.label: Open chat stream
steps.detail: The edge validates the session and opens SSE progress delivery.

steps.label: Guard and plan
steps.detail: Safety, intent and route planning select one execution branch.

steps.label: Retrieve evidence
steps.detail: BM25 and vector results are fused and confidence-gated.

steps.label: Generate answer
steps.detail: The model gateway applies the selected tier, budget and provider policy.

steps.label: Finalize
steps.detail: Evidence, safety and canonical links are joined into one answer.

steps.label: Stream result
steps.detail: Progress and answer tokens are delivered over the existing SSE channel.

scenarios.label: Publish Article
scenarios.summary: One content transaction fans out into independently replayable search, RAG and notification projections.
scenarios.result: Published content searchable, retrievable and queued for subscriber delivery

steps.label: Approve publish
steps.detail: An authenticated operator confirms a versioned content change.

steps.label: Commit content + outbox
steps.detail: Content, audit and outbox rows commit in one PostgreSQL transaction.

steps.label: Publish search event
steps.detail: The outbox relay emits the versioned search projection event.

steps.label: Update search projection
steps.detail: The consumer performs an idempotent OpenSearch upsert before acknowledgement.

steps.label: Publish RAG event
steps.detail: A separate topic preserves an independent retry and rebuild boundary.

steps.label: Replace embeddings
steps.detail: Chunks and embeddings replace the previous version idempotently.

steps.label: Dispatch publication
steps.detail: The publication event enters the recipient fan-out workflow.

steps.label: Lease recipients
steps.detail: Recipient ledger rows are claimed with idempotent delivery keys.

steps.label: Deliver update
steps.detail: The provider receives a concise HTML and text notification.

scenarios.label: Track Visitor
scenarios.summary: A bounded first-party event becomes a deduplicated session and cached public analytics projection.
scenarios.result: City-level visitor event included in sessions and rollups

steps.label: Interact with page
steps.detail: The browser emits a page, click or reading progress event.

steps.label: Create event envelope
steps.detail: Session, anonymous and request identifiers are attached at the first-party edge.

steps.label: Validate and geo-snap
steps.detail: The API validates the payload and stores only city-level location metadata.

steps.label: Append visitor event
steps.detail: The accepted event is appended to the ingestion topic.

steps.label: Dedup and aggregate
steps.detail: The consumer applies SETNX dedup, sessionization and rollup updates.

steps.label: Refresh read model
steps.detail: Public counts and map markers are served from the bounded projection.

steps.label: Render insights
steps.detail: The dashboard receives the aggregated, privacy-bounded response.

scenarios.label: Send Notification
scenarios.summary: A durable notification intent is fanned out, leased, delivered and recorded without duplicate sends.
scenarios.result: Recipient delivery recorded with provider outcome

steps.label: Create notification intent
steps.detail: A committed publication creates an outbox-backed notification event.

steps.label: Publish intent
steps.detail: Kafka preserves at-least-once delivery and replayability.

steps.label: Fan out and lease
steps.detail: The service resolves active subscribers and claims recipient leases.

steps.label: Send email
steps.detail: A provider request uses a stable idempotency key and verified sender.

steps.label: Record outcome
steps.detail: Delivery status, attempt count and provider reference are persisted.

scenarios.label: Execute MCP Tool
scenarios.summary: An external MCP client discovers and executes a sanitized portfolio tool through policy-aware adapters.
scenarios.result: Typed, sanitized tool result returned to the MCP client

steps.label: Invoke tool
steps.detail: OpenAI or Gemini submits a typed MCP request.

steps.label: Validate MCP envelope
steps.detail: The public edge enforces endpoint auth, rate limits and response bounds.

steps.label: Authorize tool
steps.detail: Registry, permission and confirmation policy select the typed adapter.

steps.label: Read content
steps.detail: The adapter executes a bounded read against the content service.

steps.label: Sanitize result
steps.detail: Secrets and internal-only fields are removed before serialization.

steps.label: Return MCP result
steps.detail: The edge returns a standards-compliant tool result with bounded metadata.

steps.label: Render result
steps.detail: The client receives the public, sanitized portfolio response.
